summary: English-medium campus university in Sharjah, with 33 undergraduate majors across architecture and design, arts and sciences, engineering and business.
about: An American liberal arts model combines general education with a professional or subject major. Options span design studios, engineering laboratories, sciences, humanities and business.

ib.text: Full Diploma: 24 points, six subjects and at least three HLs; this is a competitive guideline. IB Certificate applicants need six subjects at 4+, totalling 29+, with their school credentials assessed.

admissionRoutes.text: The 24-point guideline does not guarantee admission; programme requirements and available seats can raise the threshold.
Six subjects at 4 or above and at least 29 total; the school credential is also evaluated.

notes: Submit a personal statement and two school references (counselor and teacher). AUS must confirm how its B-equivalent subject requirements map to IB levels and grades.

Follow the admission letter’s conditions and individual deadlines. Arrange attested final school certificates/reports, UAE equivalency, relevant placement tests and file completion. An equivalency application receipt plus a conditional admission contract may permit first-semester registration while equivalency is pending.

English proof: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 (or 4.5 on the newer scale) or AUS-administered TOEFL ITP 550. IELTS Indicator, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and Linguaskill are not accepted. No IB-English exemption is promised on the published page.
Fall 2027 classes begin on 23 August. The 5 July date is early file completion; no final Fall application closing date is listed. Dates are tentative.

2026–27 tuition: AED 110,876/year for 12–16 credits per semester, plus possible lab/technology charges (AED 1,552 or 1,700 per course), activities (AED 422 plus VAT/semester) and insurance. Application costs AED 400 plus VAT. Ask for the 2027–28 schedule.

Housing prices remain labelled 2025–26: shared AED 7,000, semi-private AED 11,000 or private AED 15,000 per regular semester before VAT, plus utility/service and deposit charges. AUS lists a 25% first-year housing discount; obtain a current quote. Food and personal spending are additional.

President’s Scholarship: for secondary graduates from outside the UAE, covering tuition/labs, housing, insurance, stipend and travel. Its published IB criterion is 40 points, including predictions and prior-year performance; English requires IELTS 7 or TOEFL iBT 94. Admission is needed before applying by 1 April 2027; renewal is conditional.

Merit scholarships of 10–20% are automatically considered on equivalent 95%+ Grade 10/11 results, subject to funds. Need-based grants require an admission offer and a separate application by 10 June 2027. Sheikh Khalifa awards are for juniors/seniors, so cannot finance initial entry.
An AED 5,000 non-refundable seat deposit is due by the offer’s individual deadline. Aid may be requested before paying, but AUS does not guarantee a grant decision before that deadline.

Early admission can use school reports while final school completion is pending. Predicted IB grades are explicitly required for the President’s Scholarship; ask admissions for the general application’s exact prediction/final-results format and deadline.

support.academic: One-to-one academic coaching, study-skills workshops and first-year transition support are available through the Academic Support Center.
support.accessibility: The Academic Support Center coordinates documented accommodations, including extended-time/reduced-distraction testing. Accessible residential rooms are described; discuss individual arrangements with AUS.
support.wellbeing: University health, counseling and wellness services are available on campus.
support.careers: Career advising, mock interviews, CV support, internships and employer events support students and graduates; no placement is guaranteed.
support.internationalStudents: AUS provides student-visa information and processing support; start visa and certificate-equivalency arrangements before travel.
